questions.question: When income rises from ₹1,000 to ₹1,100, then what will be the change in savings, if the Marginal Propensity to Save is 0.7?
What is the mass ratio of carbon to oxygen in CO2?
In which sports did Kapil Parmar win the bronze medal at the Paris Paralympics 2024?
What is the target year for India to achieve net-zero emissions according to the Panchamrit action plan?
The salaries, allowances and pensions of Supreme Court Judges and CAG come from which of the following?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Consolidated Fund of India) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a primary objective of restructuring financial institutions?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Enhancing operational efficiency) है।

questions.question: Select the correct statement about religions in India as per Census 2011.
options: The growth rate of the population of the Hindu community was 26.8%.
The growth rate of the population in the decade 2001-2011 was 27.7%.
The growth rate of the population of the Jain community was 9.4%.
The growth rate of the population of the Muslim community was 24.6%.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The growth rate of the population of the Muslim community was 24.6%.) है।

questions.question: Which state’s Chief Minister conferred a cash prize of ₹1 crore each to hockey players for winning a bronze medal at the Paris Olympics in 2024?

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan) है।
